page.layout: One page of text in a single column; a small roman numeral VI. and VII. stand in the left margin beside their paragraphs. Running head at top with page number left and "LIB. II." right.

main_text.head: In Confensu Poloniae, in generali Synodo Petricovienfi, Art.4.
main_text.p: VI. Caremonias libertati Christianae donamus, ac permitti-mus, vt stantes, vel GENVA FLECTENTES, pij Sacramentum Corporis & Sanguinis CHRISTI sumant. SESSIONIS vero ad Mensam DOMINI, quia praeter ritus in omnibus per Europam Evangelicis Ec-clesiis vulgò confuetos, illi inter nos primi Authores exstite-runt, qui omnia temerè in Ecclesia immutātes, & sine scien-tia CHRISTVM QVASI imitantes, à nobis ad Arianismum perfidi transfugae facti sunt: quare hanc PROPRIAM IPSIS (ut CHRISTVM ita & sacra ejus irreverenter tractantibus) TANQVAM MINVS HONESTAM AC RELIGIOSAM, SIMPLICIORIBVSQVE ADMODVM SCAN-DALOSAM caremoniam rejicimus.
main_text.head: Item, in eodem Confenfu, in generali Synodo Vlodislaviensi, Can. 6.
main_text.p: VII. Quod attinet ad caremonias Caena DOMINI: Sen-tentia jam olim in Sendomiriensi Synodo agitata, & con-clufio in generali Cracoviensi atque Petricoviensi Synodo facta ac repetita, in hoc etiam Vlodislaviensis Synodi Con-fessu approbata est: nempe, NE IN VSV SIT SESSIO AD MENSAM DOMINI, in vllis hu-jus nostri Confensus Ecclesiis Poloniæ & Lituania, &c. Nam hac caremonia (LICET CVM CÆTERIS LI-BERA) Ecclesiis Christianis & cætibus Evangelicis non est vsitata, tantumque INFIDELIBVS ARIA-NIS, CVM DOMINO PARI SOLIO SE-SE COLLOCANTIBVS, PROPRIA. Cùm itaque SESSIO POTISSIMVM OCCA-SIONE

page.notes: Marginal roman numerals VI. and VII. are section numbers in the left margin. Ornamental letters and the Greek-looking catchword "SIONE" at the foot are a line-end fragment of "OCCASIONE". Several words in the scan are faint and partly uncertain.
